name: Vital Spike
description: Sink low with the halberd held back over the shoulder so the axe head may drop with its full weight.

name: Tempered Langet
description: Let the heavy axe head fall in a steep arc and land on the opponent's guard or shoulder.

name: Ironhaft
description: Thrust the spear point with the body's whole weight behind it so it drives deep into the target.

name: Beak Cuirass
description: Turn a heavy blow aside on the thick of the haft and let the weight carry it past.

name: Might Snatch
description: Chop the axe edge into the plate over the shoulder or chest so the metal splits and the body beneath is hurt.

name: Slaglanget
description: Swing the heavy axe head from side to side like a pendulum to hold off several attackers at once.

name: Gust Axefall
description: Rise on the toes and drop the whole body behind a qi-loaded axe blow that cleaves helm and bone.

name: Hoarfrost Tailstop
description: Plant the butt and lean the head forward so the haft and the axe block every blow from the front.

name: Fortifying Langet
description: Hold the halberd low and wide so the beak and axe edge both face the opponent's shield.

name: Raging Spikefall
description: Chop down onto the upper rim of a shield to drive it down and expose the head.

name: Tempered Axeheel
description: Poke the spear point under a lowered shield rim at the legs or belly.

name: Hoarfrost Socketring
description: Latch the beak over the shield edge and hold it fast so the holder cannot raise it.

name: Rumble Heave
description: Hook the beak into a shield's rim and rip it sideways to tear it from the arm.

name: Axefall Torment
description: Cleave through the rim of a shield with qi along the edge so the wood or plate splits.

name: Beakbarrage
description: Drive the spear point through the gap between two shields or between shield and body.

name: Downpour Spike
description: Sweep the axe edge along a row of shields with qi so that the front of the line is torn open.

name: Langetbarrage
description: Hook the shield aside with the beak and follow with a cleave into the guard that has just opened.

name: Renewing Socketring
description: Stand with qi spread along the haft and beyond the head so the halberd feels longer than it is.

name: Drag Barrage
description: Cut with the axe blade so the field of qi at the edge lands a hand's breadth beyond the steel.

name: Rumble Spikefall
description: Thrust so the qi field around the point reaches past the steel and strikes before the metal does.

name: Unshaken Axeheel
description: Brush an incoming blade with the qi field around the haft and turn it before it reaches the wood.

name: Glancing Hookback
description: Step to the exact edge of the halberd's field so every strike lands at its farthest reach.

name: Iron Snatch
description: Push the axe blade's qi field out a full pace farther and cut at a foe who thought himself clear.

name: Hamstringing Beak
description: Cast the qi field of the beak around a limb or weapon and pull it fast from afar.

name: Heaveassault
description: Send a pulse of qi ahead of the thrust so the spike point arrives with its force already landed.

name: Scalding Granite Drag
description: Swing the axe so the qi field sweeps a wide arc beyond the steel and clears all within it.

name: Heavebarrage
description: Gather qi at the point and loose it as one narrow thrust that pierces a body beyond the halberd's length.

name: Crownspike Tincture
description: Hold the halberd with the beak out front and the axe edge cocked behind it.

name: Dragplating
description: Hook the beak at the hip or the thigh and pull so the opponent's stance tilts toward the axe.

name: Dragassault
description: Cleave the axe edge across the opponent who has been pulled off balance by the beak.

name: Aegis Axeblade
description: Brace the haft crosswise to answer a hook so that the beak's pull is stopped at the shaft.

name: Rumble Haft
description: Peel an enemy hook off the haft by rolling the shaft against its curve and pulling away.

name: Langetcanter
description: Step back along the line of a hook that has just pulled so the pull gains the opponent nothing.

name: Blazeheave
description: Drag the hooked opponent forward across the body and meet them with the axe in the same turn.

name: Glint Tailstop
description: Answer an enemy hook with a spike thrust into the hand or wrist that holds the hooking weapon.

name: Hoarfrost Drag
description: Set the beak so firmly in an opponent's gear that qi in the haft will not let it slip.

name: Ironspike
description: Hold the locked opponent in place with the beak and bring the axe down in a splitting descent.

name: Gust Beak
description: Flow the haft under an incoming cleave and carry it past before returning an axe cut of your own.

name: Equipoise Langet
description: Take the ready pose from which every stroke of the compendium may be begun without a preparatory step.

name: Mighthaft
description: Open with a straight chop of the axe blade as the first stroke of the grand series.

name: Tempered Hookpull
description: Follow with a straight thrust of the spear point as the second stroke of the series.

name: Steadfast Axeblade
description: Catch the answering blow on the haft and turn it aside to prepare the next stroke.

name: Chimeheave
description: Hook the opponent's weapon with the beak to keep the series from being interrupted.

name: Silt Spike
description: Retreat a pace to reset the stance when the first strokes of the series have been answered.

name: Harrowing Axefall
description: Chain several cleaves in sequence with qi flowing steadily from one blow to the next.

name: Iron Tailstop
description: Run forward with a string of quick thrusts that each seek a different gap in the armor.

name: Axeheel Cuirass
description: Wheel the halberd in a ring before the body so that every angle of attack meets the shaft.

name: Rumble Socketring
description: Sweep the beak low along the ground to hook both ankles and drop an advancing opponent.

name: Granite Hookback
description: Gather every earlier stroke into one qi-loaded cleave that splits guard armor and the body behind them.

name: Splintering Snatch
description: Gather every earlier stroke into a single lunge that skewers through the shield and the arm behind it.

name: Vital Axeblade
description: Stand with weight on two tracks so that either the axe or the spike may strike without shifting the feet.

name: Langetthrash
description: Chop down with the curved axe edge as a hawk's talon strikes and seizes in one stoop.

name: Rumbledrag
description: Prick the sharp beak at the throat or the eye in a short darting stab.

name: Resilient Beak
description: Parry twice in rhythm with the haft so the first parry opens the line for the second.

name: Blaze Crownspike
description: Cut downward twice from the same stance on two tracks so the blows land a heartbeat apart.

name: Glint Spikefall
description: Pull with the beak and thrust with the spike in a paired move so the hold and the wound come together.

name: Silt Snatch
description: Glide forward on a long smooth line like a hawk on a clear sky current to close the distance.

name: Rumble Langet
description: Gather qi overhead and stoop in one fast leap with the axe falling like a diving hawk.

name: Doctrine Heave
description: Run a cleave down one track and a thrust down the other so both land before the guard can settle.

name: Perceptive Haft
description: Stand with the halberd cradled low like a river pooling in a basin before it spills.

name: Iron Heave
description: Cut the axe edge along a curving path like a river bend that arrives from the opponent's blind side.

name: Drubbing Socketring
description: Run the spear point straight and steady along the line like a river in its channel.

name: Aegis Hookback
description: Hold the haft as a basin's rim around the body so that any blow slides off and away.

name: Gust Drag
description: Cross the gap between you and the foe in sure stepping paces as one crosses a river ford.

name: Tailstop Cuirass
description: Hook the opponent's gear and drag with the steady pull of a current that cannot be resisted.

name: Silt Hookpull
description: Cleave outward in a surging arc that pushes back anyone near like a river in flood.

name: Equipoise Crownspike
description: Turn the haft in a circling eddy around an incoming blow and draw it harmlessly off.

name: Iron Spikefall
description: Bring a cut and a thrust together from two directions at one point as two rivers meet.

name: Silencing Axeheel
description: Wind the haft and beak around the opponent's weapon and hold it still as water holds in a pool.

name: Rousing Langet
description: Hold the halberd with the axe head as the left wing and the spike as the right wing of the body.

name: Severing Hookpull
description: Cut with the axe edge from the left wing across the opponent's guard.

name: Facethaft
description: Dart the spear point from the right wing at the gap the left wing cut has opened.

name: Enduring Crownspike
description: Fold both wings in against the body with the haft crossing the front to stop a blow.

name: Granite Spike
description: Beat the feet in two quick paces like wings to change the angle of the halberd's approach.

name: Heave Cloak
description: Catch the opponent's weapon on the wingtip beak and hold it while the other wing strikes.

name: Snatchtorment
description: Sweep the axe and the spike through two paired arcs that clear the ground on both sides.

name: Rumble Hookpull
description: Drive the spear point from under the shadow of a raised axe wing into the exposed body.

name: Grinding Axefall
description: Close both wings of the stance on the target and bring the axe down with qi in the edge.

name: Gyvebeak
description: Press the beak over the opponent's weapon and lock it down with a steady stream of qi.

name: Might Beak
description: Hold the halberd in the ready pose of the basin court with weight balanced on both feet.

name: Dragtorment
description: Chop down onto the opponent's guard from the court floor in a counted drilled stroke.

name: Axeblade Torment
description: Jab the spear point at the opponent's hand in the count that follows the chop.

name: Adamant Haft
description: Parry at the court's edge with the haft and answer on the next count.

name: Mayhem Snatch
description: Hook the opponent's leg and drag them down to the court floor in one pull.

name: Blaze Spikefall
description: Sweep the axe around the whole circuit of the court to hold off foes on every side.

name: Trouncing Tailstop
description: Answer an opponent's cut with a thrust timed to the next count of the court.

name: Splintering Drag
description: Bring the axe down in a qi-loaded cleave that ends the drilled exchange.

name: Granite Socketring
description: Wheel the haft in a steady ring of qi that blocks every line into the court.

name: Daybreak Spike
description: Stand sideways to the wind and set the halberd along the bearing the sworn fighter has taken.

name: Snatchthrash
description: Cut with the axe edge across the wind so the gust adds its push to the blow.

name: Iron Axeheel
description: Thrust into the wind with the point low so that the gust gives it no purchase to turn.

name: Equipoise Spike
description: Parry on the sheltered side of the body where the wind does not push the haft off line.

name: Rumblesnatch
description: Hook the beak in time with a gust so the pull and the wind together overturn the opponent.

name: Daybreak Axeblade
description: Sweep the axe blade level along the held bearing and keep the line true as the wind shifts.

name: Axefall Onslaught
description: Draw the wind into the swing with qi and cleave with a force far past the arm's own.

name: Thorn Axeheel
description: Spin the halberd in a sworn screen that the wind itself holds firm against any blow from the front.

name: Intent Crownspike
description: Stand with the heels near the plateau edge and the halberd held level into the open air.

name: Harpooning Langet
description: Chop the axe blade downward from the edge so the opponent is driven back toward the drop.

name: Iron Beak
description: Thrust the spear point along the edge's line so the foe has no room to slip away.

name: Thorn Haft
description: Hold the haft upright to break the wind and a blow together before they reach the body.

name: Crippling Hookback
description: Snatch at an opponent's belt with the beak near the drop and pull them from their footing.

name: Silt Socketring
description: Retreat along the plateau in even paces that never lose the edge or the sworn bearing.

name: Needling Snatch
description: Chain cleaves without pause as one keeps an oath unbroken through every gust of the wind.

name: Glint Heave
description: Thrust upward on the edge's updraft so the spike lifts the opponent's guard before the point lands.

name: Ponderous Axefall
description: Hook an opponent at the edge and haul them back from the drop or off their feet toward it.

name: Hookpull Barrage
description: Fall with the plateau wind behind the axe and split guard and body in a single descending stroke.

name: Slagbeak
description: Sweep a wide qi-edged arc under the open sky that clears the ground of any who stand against the oath.

name: Might Hookback
description: Stand with the halberd held far back and the gale pressing on the shoulders.

name: Haftassault
description: Hew the axe blade out at full reach with the gale driving the swing.

name: Heavetorment
description: Thrust the spear point out at full reach with the wind behind the shoulder.

name: Implacable Socketring
description: Turn the haft into an incoming blow and let the gale carry it past.

name: Rumblebeak
description: Tap the beak against the opponent's weapon to spoil the timing of the next blow.

name: Tailstop Pounce
description: Pace back before the wind to keep the foe at the farthest edge of reach.

name: Toxinspike
description: Hook a weapon at full reach and wrench it away in the direction of the gale.

name: Daybreak Hookpull
description: Sweep the axe in a wide arc at the end of its reach to drive back a crowd.

name: Glintlanget
description: Run forward on the wind with a line of long thrusts at the foe's guard.

name: Mantled Spike
description: Wheel the halberd in a ring at full reach so that no blow crosses to the body.

name: Gustlanget
description: Fall forward with the far gale at the back and cleave through the guard.

name: Nova Axeheel
description: Gather qi and rush ahead on the gale with the spear point skewering through armor.

name: Mindful Beak
description: Stand with the toes at the open edge and the halberd level against the wind.

name: Beaktorment
description: Chop down from the open edge so the foe is driven back toward the drop.

name: Novaheave
description: Poke the spear point at the opponent's lead foot where the ground is narrow.

name: Annealed Haft
description: Slip the haft along an incoming blade and let the wind push it wide.

name: Blazesnatch
description: Rake the beak down the opponent's guard in time with a gust of wind.

name: Blurring Axefall
description: Glide along the open edge in short paces that never lose the line of the wind.

name: Rumblespike
description: Rush along the edge and split the guard with a qi-loaded axe stroke.

name: Annealed Facet Hookback
description: Hold a sworn guard of qi along the haft at the edge so the wind braces the blow aside.

name: Rousing Crownspike
description: Stand a pace ahead of the squad with the halberd raised so every man can see the head and the beak.

name: Glintspike
description: Thrust the spike at the first man of a guard line on the call so the whole squad thrusts with him.

name: Staunch Haft
description: Brace the haft against a wagon corner to hold the gap between two wagons against two guards at once.

name: Beaksprint
description: Advance one pace on the squad leader's call with the beak forward so the whole squad steps and strikes together.

name: Staggering Heave
description: Hook the beak under the arm of a driver on his box seat and heave him down onto the road.

name: Ponderous Haft
description: Drive the haft crosswise into a guard line with the squad leaning behind it and shove the whole line back.

name: Splitting Axeblade
description: Hew with qi packed into the axe edge to split the iron bands of a strongbox or the shield beside it.

name: Manacling Hookback
description: Pin a guard's blade against the wagon rail with the haft and hold it fast with steady qi while the squad closes.
